verdict.rationale: The axis applies because treg is a proxy/gateway that every tool call passes through, but the evidence never documents a per-call log, audit trail, or replay capability. The closest items are a CALL_ID used for rating calls (treg-docs-12) and `balance` reporting aggregate daily usage (treg-docs-33). Neither amounts to a viewable log of calls with enough detail to audit or replay an agent's actions.
